road.title: Hello and goodbye
road.place: The Forgotten Dell on the Wrong Side
road.description: A stooped and careful soul under a hat that has seen service, with a lantern that is lit in broad daylight, to be safe. Marigold is a Doorkeeper Without a Door and guards an entrance that was removed for cleaning years ago and has not been told.

openObjectives.prompt: Marigold is plainly waiting to be greeted and will not be the one to start. Greet Marigold, using Italian.
Marigold is holding a list and a pencil, and you are not on the list. Tell Marigold your name, using Italian.
Marigold has asked how you are and, unusually, wants to know. Tell Marigold how you are, using Italian.

character.name: Marigold Lintel
character.description: A stooped and careful soul under a hat that has seen service, with a lantern that is lit in broad daylight, to be safe. Marigold is a Doorkeeper Without a Door and guards an entrance that was removed for cleaning years ago and has not been told.

npc.narrative: È mattina, e a light pioggia falls on the Forgotten Dell. Marigold Lintel stands dritta beside a gap in the siepe, guarding a porta that is not there. Near her stivali sits a small tin marked cappello, and the nearest strada is due panini away.
npc.native: Buongiorno e salve! Mi chiamo Marigold Lintel e sto bene, anche con la pioggia. Risparmio per un cappello, ma questa è un'altra storia. E tu, come ti chiami, come stai oggi e che cosa pensi della mia porta?
npc.translation: Good morning and hello! My name is Marigold Lintel and I am fine, even with the rain. I am saving up for a hat, but that is another story. And you, what is your name, how are you today and what do you think of my door?

verdict.overallFeedback: Nice work: you greeted Marigold and told her your name in good Italian. Next, tell her how you are.

objectiveResults.feedback: Passed: "Buongiorno!" is a lovely, correct greeting.
Passed: "Mi chiamo Tom" correctly tells Marigold your name.
You haven't yet said how you are today. Marigold will ask again later, so try telling her how you're feeling.

openObjectives.prompt: Marigold has asked how you are and, unusually, wants to know. Tell Marigold how you are, using Italian.

npc.narrative: La pioggia taps on the brim of nothing as Marigold bows to you, grandly, toward the spot where a porta should be. A gatto walks through the gap without asking and is granted a nod. On the ledge sits a small jar labelled cappello, rattling slightly with soldi.
npc.native: Piacere, Tom, e buongiorno anche a te! Io sto bene, ma il mio fondo per il cappello va così così. Con questa pioggia leggera non c'è male. Come stai tu oggi, e che cosa pensi della mia porta?
npc.translation: Pleased to meet you, Tom, and good morning to you too! I am fine, but my fund for the hat is going so-so. With this light rain, it is not bad. How are you today, and what do you think of my door?

correction.text: Sto bene, grazie. La porta... non capisco.
correction.translation: I'm fine, thank you. The door... I don't understand.

verdict.overallFeedback: Nice work answering Marigold in Italian, and it's fine to say you don't understand. Next time try \"Sto bene\" for the full phrase.

objectiveResults.feedback: You said how you are with "Bene, grazie", which is close, but the full phrase is "Sto bene".

correction.text: Sto bene, grazie. La porta... non capisco.
correction.translation: I'm fine, thank you. The door... I don't understand.

npc.narrative: Marigold Lintel stands very straight in front of nothing at all, one mano resting on a latta marked HAT. The pioggia taps politely on the spot where a porta would be. A gatto walks through it, and nobody remarks.
npc.native: Bene, Tom, anch'io sto bene! La porta è qui, vedi? Non c'è, ma è in pulizia da molti anni. E tu, che cosa fai oggi sotto la pioggia?
npc.translation: Good, Tom, I am fine too! The door is here, you see? It is not there, but it has been being cleaned for many years. And you, what are you doing today in the rain?

npc.narrative: Marigold Lintel stands very straight beside the empty frame, one hand on a maniglia that is not there. La pioggia falls on her bare testa, where a cappello will one day go. The strada past the muro is two panini long, and nobody has measured it twice.
npc.native: Non capisci? Non è un problema, Tom! La mia porta è grande, ma oggi non c'è. Dove vai con questa pioggia, e che cosa vuoi sapere del mio lavoro?
npc.translation: You don't understand? It's not a problem, Tom! My door is big, but today it isn't here. Where are you going in this rain, and what do you want to know about my work?

npc.narrative: Under the pioggia, Marigold Lintel stands very dritta beside a piece of aria where the porta should be. She gives a small nod, as to someone who has finally asked the right domanda. The nearest panino is a long walk off, and she does not mention it.
npc.native: Ciao, Tom! Io sto bene, grazie, anche se la pioggia cade sul mio cappello vecchio. Il fondo per un cappello nuovo è ancora molto piccolo. Che cosa vuoi sapere del mio lavoro, e che cosa fai tu di bello oggi?
npc.translation: Hello, Tom! I am well, thank you, even if the rain falls on my old hat. The fund for a new hat is still very small. What do you want to know about my work, and what nice thing are you doing today?

npc.narrative: You turn to go, but Marigold raises una mano with the gravity of someone stopping a carriage. The pioggia has made a small lago where the door would be, and she guards it with great dignità. Behind her, the grigio sky sits on the hills like a lid.
npc.native: Già arrivederci, Tom? Ma la strada è lunga: sono due panini! Io resto qui con la mia porta e il mio fondo per il cappello. Dove vai dopo, e che cosa vuoi sapere del mio lavoro?
npc.translation: Goodbye already, Tom? But the road is long: it is two sandwiches! I stay here with my door and my hat fund. Where do you go next, and what do you want to know about my work?
